deploy-bot: 🚀 Staging deploy started
deploy-bot: env=staging commit=97a3b2d tag=v2.4.1-rc triggered_by=@maya change_window=2026-03-20T22:00:00Z..2026-03-20T22:30:00Z canary=5% expected_duration=12m runbook=https://wiki.redwood/prod/deploys/staging-smoke CI=passed
maya: kicking off smoke tests now, will watch p95 latencies and error-rate dashboards :eyes:
kevin: noted. can we pin the reranker model to v1.9 for this rollout? last time auto-roll caused variance.
maya: good call — pinning reranker to v1.9 in the rollout config now (`reranker: v1.9`).
sasha: quick checklist: 1) db-migrations noop 2) feature-flag for new-tokenizer off 3) monitor kv-cache hit rate. tagging @oliver for infra knobs.
oliver: infra's green, node counts stable. I bumped autoscaler threshold to +10% for the window. ops-bot: cluster capacity check OK — staging-gpu-pool has 4 spare slots.
maya: canary traffic shifted to new instances, running basic prompts against /v1/chat to validate tokenization.
kevin: running corpus eval locally, will post results in ~3m.
kevin: eval quick summary — quality delta negligible, latency p95 +18ms but within SLO. sending full diff to #eng-ml.
sasha: if p95 goes above +120ms we should pause. agree to proceed for now. :+1:
deploy-bot: canary health checks: all green (success_rate=99.7% errors=0.3% p95=168ms). proceeding with gradual shift.
maya: shifting to 30% traffic. smoke metrics look stable.
kevin: small warning in reranker logs for a rare token edge-case, not impacting throughput. I filed ENG-3245.
ops-bot: auto-heal watchers running; no restarts triggered.
maya: shifting remaining 70% — starting full cutover.
deploy-bot: FULL DEPLOY COMPLETE ✅ env=staging commit=97a3b2d tag=v2.4.1-rc duration=7m48s canary_peak=30s final_status=success notes="reranker pinned to v1.9, autoscaler bumped for window"
maya: thanks all — post-deploy checklist: run sanity evals in 15m and confirm no regressions in scheduled job runs.
kevin: sanity evals queued, will report in thread.
sasha: leaving feature-flag off for another 24h then we'll toggle after product sign-off.
oliver: rolling back autoscaler threshold to default in 30m if no issues.
maya: nice work team. :tada:
kevin: sanity evals show no regressions, p95 stable. closing this thread unless someone sees anything odd.
ops-bot: reminder: create release note snippet for staging -> ready to promote when copy approved.
maya: added short release blurb to the release draft.
kevin: ack — tagging @product for review.
maya: closing deploy thread — marking as successful.
